product: Skills in Genie One support multiple files and folders
tagline: A Genie One skill can now include multiple files and sub folders, up to three folders deep and 50 files or folders per skill.
what_it_does: A Genie One skill can now include multiple files and sub folders, up to three folders deep and 50 files or folders per skill. Skills can load text files only. Chat in Genie One is a unified, full screen natural language interface for business users to ask data questions.
why_it_matters: Low: This level lowers the cost for simpler tasks.
plain_summary: A Genie One skill can now include multiple files and sub folders, up to three folders deep and 50 files or folders per skill. Skills can load text files only.
